visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair and glasses wears a pink button-down shirt over a white tee. She holds two miniature scones filled with jam in a bright, modern kitchen setting with white cabinetry and wooden accents. A tiny version of her stands between the scones. (2) Close-up shots focus on hands cutting a cold block of yellow butter into uniform cubes on a wooden board. Multiple camera angles show the butter being tossed into a clear food processor alongside white flour, sugar, salt, and baking powder. (3) The woman uses a black immersion blender to pulse the dry ingredients. A miniature overlay of herself is seen talking and pointing near the appliance. The background remains the bright studio kitchen with blurred utensils. (4) Cream and a yellow liquid (egg) are poured into the food processor. The mixture turns into crumbly sandy granules. The person then pours the granules onto a sheet of plastic wrap laid flat on the white kitchen table. (5) The person uses her hands to press the crumbly dough through the plastic wrap, folding it several times. A wooden rolling pin is used to flatten the dough into a rectangular slab. A wooden ruler is held against the side to verify the 2cm height. (6) The scone dough is placed into a freezer drawer among other frozen items. Later, a small circular metal ring is dipped into flour and used to punch out mini circles from the firm dough. The tiny character jumps on the cutter to help. (7) An egg is cracked, and the yolk is separated into a bowl. A small brush is used to paint the bright yellow egg wash onto the tops of several mini scone rounds arranged on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. (8) The baking tray is slid into a small white toaster oven. A close-up view through the glass shows the scones expanding vertically and the tops browning under the glowing orange heating coils. (9) The finished golden-brown scones are shown on a wooden tray. The scene cuts to a greenhouse where the same woman holds three large red strawberries. Close-ups show jars of Strawberry Jam and Milkyberry Jam. (10) A spoon lifts a large chunk of red strawberry fruit from the jam jar. The jam is spread onto a split scone. The woman is shown enjoying the food, with the tiny character appearing again in a celebratory pose on the table.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic female voice introducing the video topic in Mandarin. The background music (BGM) is a cheerful, acoustic pop track with a moderate tempo of about 120 BPM, featuring bright guitar strums and a light rhythmic beat. (2) A high-pitched, comedic version of the same female voice interjects with playful remarks. The BGM remains consistent in the background. A sharp whoosh sound effect accompanies a visual transition, followed by a soft shimmer effect for a graphic pop-up. (3) During the cooking montage, the narration remains instructional and clear. We hear the distinct rhythmic thud of a knife hitting a wooden board while cutting butter, and the clatter of ingredients being poured into a plastic container. (4) The loud, mechanical whirring of a food processor is heard in short pulses, synchronized with the speaker's enthusiastic vocal delivery. The sound has a broad frequency range and high intensity, temporarily dominating the mix over the BGM. (5) The sound of plastic wrap rustling and crinkling is prominent, followed by the thumping of hands pressing the dough. The high-pitched vocal persona returns with a short, strained I'm okay while the rolling pin makes a low-frequency rolling sound. (6) A metallic click and sliding sound indicate a drawer being opened. This is followed by a metallic clink of a ring cutter and a sharp impact sound as it punches through the dough, underscored by a cartoonish jumping sound effect. (7) The sharp crack of an eggshell is followed by a liquid splash sound into glass. The speaker's voice is friendly and calm, maintaining high articulation clarity. The BGM continues with its uplifting, major-mode tonality. (8) A digital beep or mechanical click signals the start of the oven timer. The BGM maintains a steady rhythm as the speaker's tone shifts to anticipation. The spectral brightness remains high, giving the track a clean, polished broadcast quality. (9) As the jam product is introduced, the vocal delivery becomes more descriptive and persuasive. A soft clink of a spoon against a glass jar is heard. The video concludes with a group cheer Oishi! and light laughter as the music resolves.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Step-by-step Process -> Product Feature -> Result -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a dual-purpose piece of content: it provides a detailed, accessible tutorial for making mini scones while simultaneously promoting high-quality Japanese strawberry jams (Skyberry and Milkyberry) through a time-limited group buy campaign.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly mentions a group buy period (2/18-2/25), shows specific jam jars with labels, and highlights the premium quality of the ingredients used.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes a miniature version of the creator as a visual motif to maintain engagement during technical cooking steps. The high editing pace and synchronized sound effects create a dynamic viewing experience typical of social media cooking content.
